name: Hiring & Recruiting
description: Track candidates from application through offer. Each swimlane is a department; each card is a candidate or hiring action.

swimlanes.name: Engineering
swimlanes.notes: Backend, frontend, and infrastructure roles. Python/Django and React/TypeScript. Remote-friendly.

swimlanes.name: Product
swimlanes.notes: Product managers and product analysts. B2B SaaS experience preferred. Reports to CPO.

swimlanes.name: Design
swimlanes.notes: Product designers and UX researchers. Figma expertise required. Systems design thinking valued.

swimlanes.name: Sales
swimlanes.notes: Account executives and SDRs. B2B SaaS with PLG experience. OTE $120-180k.

swimlanes.name: Marketing
swimlanes.notes: Content, growth, and demand gen roles. PLG experience required. Reports to Head of Marketing.

swimlanes.name: Customer Success
swimlanes.notes: CSMs and CS Ops. SaaS experience required. Owns onboarding, retention, and expansion.

swimlanes.name: Operations
swimlanes.notes: DevOps, IT, and business operations. Kubernetes and Terraform experience for DevOps roles.

swimlanes.name: Finance
swimlanes.notes: Accounting, FP&A, and revenue ops. SaaS metrics experience preferred. CPA for accounting roles.

swimlanes.name: Legal
swimlanes.notes: Corporate counsel and compliance. SaaS contracts, IP, and data privacy experience required.

swimlanes.name: Executive
swimlanes.notes: VP and C-level searches. Board-approved headcount only. Executive recruiter engaged.
